claims.summary: The origin carries a section number and heading on costs, attorney fees, and expenses; the descendant has no such heading.
The descendant opens with an enacting clause placing the text as a new section in a new chapter of title 15; the origin has no such clause.
The origin ties the fee award to a motion under Section 78B-25-103, introduced before the award language and referred to as 'the motion'.
The descendant ties the fee award to a motion filed under section 3 of this Act.

claims.summary: The origin is codified as section 78B-25-110 titled costs, attorney fees, and expenses; the descendant is framed as an act section adding a new section to a new chapter in title 15.
